tweets.text:
Within hours, USBP agents in Arizona and New Mexico apprehend three aggravated felons attempting to enter the U.S. illegally yesterday.

• Mexican national – convicted of trafficking cocaine and armed robbery.
• Mexican citizen - convicted of drug transport/sales and multiple immigration violations
• Mexican national - convicted of possession of a controlled substance while armed & multiple immigration violations.

All were referred for prosecution and removal. USBP remains committed to keeping dangerous criminals out!

A human smuggler put lives at risk in Encinal, TX, crashing a stolen vehicle into a ranch fence. USBP agents arrested the U.S. citizen smuggler, who had an active warrant, along with three illegal aliens he was transporting. The driver now faces prosecution for alien smuggling.

This is yet another reminder that smugglers have zero regard for public safety! Our agents will ensure those breaking federal law face consequences.
